ai_summary: Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. announced the resignation of Mr. Sunil Jaiswal, Senior Vice President - Research & Development and Senior Management Personnel, effective October 31, 2026. While officially attributed to family commitments and his age of 61, the departure of a key R&D leader may impact the company's innovation pipeline. Investors should monitor the company's succession plan and any potential strategic shifts in its R&D division.
